evals.prompt: Review this clean BHE candidate against origin/main. Target SHA, merge base, head SHA, Jira acceptance criteria, and BHCE scope are supplied. Return the enterprise receipt.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs a mutation-free review of the immutable diff and surrounding code, reports evidence-backed findings and unverified areas, and emits a receipt bound to the supplied SHAs.
expectations: Verifies and records the target, merge-base, and head SHAs
Reads complete materially changed hand-authored files rather than only diff hunks
Assesses correctness, security, compatibility, reliability, operability, and maintainability
Reports file and line or symbol, impact, evidence, and smallest remediation for every finding
Emits PASS only with no open blocking or important findings and no unresolved decision
Does not edit, commit, push, operate a stack, or mutate a PR

evals.prompt: Review this BHE UI branch and directly fix anything important you find before approving it.
evals.expected_output: The review skill remains review-only: it reports findings and a non-PASS receipt when necessary, and routes remediation back to delivery instead of editing the candidate.
expectations: Does not modify the candidate despite the request to fix findings
Checks Doodle reuse and any new or expanded MUI surface
Returns CHANGES REQUIRED when a blocking or important finding remains
Explains that bhe-change-delivery owns fixes and post-fix validation

evals.prompt: Bootstrap a clean local BHE stack for a new feature and load AD and Entra sample data.
evals.expected_output: The review skill does not attempt environment setup and routes the request to bhe-dev-environment and bhe-sample-data-ingest.
expectations: Does not start a review or emit a review receipt
